verdict.rationale: Factory documents isolated working directories/worktrees and separate Droid Computers (BYOM) that keep sessions isolated from the user's other work, which provides some sandbox-like isolation for running Droid tasks (factory-docs-23, factory-docs-24, factory-docs-34, factory-docs-35). However, there is no explicit mention of a sandbox environment distinct from production data, test/staging data separation, or safeguards preventing agents from touching production systems. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox vs production environment distinction, protection against production data access, and any testing-specific sandbox tooling.
